overview: White fianchettoes and Black builds a QGD-like set-up with ...d5 and ...e6. After Nf3, d4 and c4 it becomes a Catalan, or White can aim for a King's Indian Attack with d3, O-O and e4. Slow, manoeuvring play with the bishop on g2 pressing d5.

white_ideas.idea: Nf3, d4, c4 for a Catalan with long-diagonal pressure on d5.
Or d3, Nbd2, e4 in KIA style.

black_ideas.idea: Develop ...Nf6, ...Be7, ...O-O with ...c5 or ...dxc4 to free the game.
Meet the Catalan with ...dxc4 and hold the pawn or play ...c6 solidly.

typical_structures.structure: Catalan: pawns on d4 and c4 against d5 and e6 with the bishop on g2.

character.notes: Slow, strategic, sound for both sides.

structure.notes: Flank set-up with an undecided centre.

approach.notes: g3/Bg2 plus Nf3 is a general system against most replies.

level.notes: Plans are clear; transpositions matter more than memory.

character.reason: Quiet positional play with few early tactics.

structure.reason: Flank opening with the centre not yet decided.

approach.reason: g3/Bg2/Nf3 set-up usable against most defences.

level.reason: Plans are fairly clear but Catalan-like pressure takes skill.

plans.reason: Bishop on g2 on the long diagonal.
